title.en: An Act Constituting the First Representative District of the Province of Albay Into a Separate Highway Engineering District.
title.orig: An Act Constituting the First Representative District of the Province of Albay Into a Separate Highway Engineering District.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6308_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the First Representative District of Albay is hereby constituted into a separate highway engineering district to be known as the First Highway Engineering District of the Province of Albay. It shall have one highway district engineer who shall be appointed in accordance with existing laws.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1971
